name: Strong Kangen Water
description: Strong Kangen Water has a very high pH (11.5) and strong alkalinity. It is not for drinking but excels at cleaning, food preparation, and removing pesticides from produce. Its strong dissolving and heat-conducting properties make it ideal for household cleaning tasks.
uses: Cleaning vegetables and fruits (removes pesticides/oil-based residues)
Pre-boiling vegetables (enhances flavor, reduces cooking time)
Cleaning cutting boards, dishes, and kitchen surfaces
Soaking beans and legumes (reduces cooking time)

name: Kangen Water (pH 9.5)
description: The most popular drinking water type. With a pH of 9.5, this alkaline water is rich in molecular hydrogen (antioxidant) and minerals. Recommended for daily drinking, cooking, and making beverages. As stated by the manufacturer, it helps maintain the body's pH balance.

name: Kangen Water (pH 9.0)
description: Milder alkaline water suitable for those new to Kangen Water or with sensitive systems. Good for daily drinking and cooking. As stated by the manufacturer, it provides gentle alkalinity and antioxidant properties.

name: Kangen Water (pH 8.5)
description: The mildest Kangen Water, ideal for first-time users, children, and the elderly. Gentle introduction to alkaline water. As stated by the manufacturer, it offers subtle alkalinity with hydrogen antioxidant benefits.

name: Clean Water
description: Neutral pH water (7.0) filtered through the machine's high-grade filter but not ionized. Removes chlorine, lead, and impurities while retaining minerals. Same quality as premium filtered water.
uses: Taking medications (as neutral pH doesn't affect absorption)
For those advised by doctors to avoid alkaline water

name: Beauty Water
description: Slightly acidic water (pH 5.5-6.0) that matches the skin's natural pH. Excellent for facial cleansing, hair care, and skin toning. As stated by the manufacturer, it has astringent properties that help tighten pores and condition hair.

name: Strong Acidic Water
description: Very low pH water (2.5) with strong oxidizing properties. NOT FOR DRINKING. For external use only. As stated by the manufacturer, it has sanitizing properties and can be used for cleaning and disinfecting surfaces.
